description: Return the full audit trail / event log for a formation. Shows every status change, portal sync, webhooks, and notes. Useful for debugging or understanding where a formation is in the pipeline.

formation_id.description: Formation ID whose audit trail to retrieve (op_fm_* format).

limit.description: Max events to return (default 50, max 500). Events are ordered newest-first.

name: offshoreproz_get_formation_events
